component.name: YestreamScene
component.script:
sub init() m.topNav = m.top.findNode("topNav") m.homeScreen = m.top.findNode("homeScreen") m.liveTvScreen = m.top.findNode("liveTvScreen") m.playlistsScreen = m.top.findNode("playlistsScreen") m.expiryLockScreen = m.top.findNode("expiryLockScreen")
m.topNav.observeField("activeTabIndex", "onTabChanged")
initializeDevice() end sub
sub initializeDevice() identity = loadStoredIdentity() m.top.deviceId = getDeviceId() m.top.macAddress = identity.mac m.top.deviceKey = identity.key6
' Register device with backend payload = { mac: identity.mac, hardwareFingerprint: m.top.deviceId, platform: "Roku", model: CreateObject("roDeviceInfo").GetModel(), appVersion: "0.1.0" }
regRes = registerDevice(payload) if regRes.ok and regRes.data <> invalid if regRes.data.credential <> invalid identity.credential = regRes.data.credential saveStoredIdentity(identity) end if end if end sub
sub onTabChanged() idx = m.topNav.activeTabIndex m.homeScreen.visible = (idx = 0) m.liveTvScreen.visible = (idx = 1) m.playlistsScreen.visible = (idx = 2)
if idx = 2 m.playlistsScreen.setFocus(true) else if idx = 1 m.liveTvScreen.setFocus(true) else m.homeScreen.setFocus(true) end if end sub
